Heart Transplant Connects Cities, Saves Four Lives

A heart donated in Indore was transported to Ahmedabad for a transplant, marking the 26th such retrieval from Indore. The donated heart belonged to a local individual whose organs will also help four other people. This event highlights Indore's role in organ donation, following its recognition for cleanliness.
